actor_digest_method: Sorted model state_dict entries excluding value.*; UTF8 parameter name then contiguous NumPy bytes.

checked: verified matching piece streams and played prefixes

excluded_rows.reason: Duplicate partial second-seed block replaced by its complete single-seed job.
Duplicate partial second-seed block replaced by its complete single-seed job.

assembly.method: Validated union of one complete seed from interrupted first job and three complete single-seed jobs; paired statistics recomputed over the four game seeds.

final_checkpoint_link.scope: Gameplay was measured on the actor-stage checkpoint. This separate combined checkpoint has identical actor parameters, inference config and embedded teacher; only its critic calibration was added.

limitations: All 36 runs were capped at 512 placements with zero clears. These are functional checks of early gameplay, not lifetime strength evidence.
All paired capped-survival deltas and bootstrap intervals are zero because every run is censored at the same cap; this does not establish equal uncapped survival.
Only four independent game seeds were used. Action repeats are averaged within game seed.
First seed was run sequentially; the remaining three seed jobs overlapped on a shared CPU. Timing is not a controlled throughput comparison.

This report evaluates the actor-only checkpoint before critic calibration. Any combined checkpoint must be linked by identical actor parameter/config digests, not presented as the same checkpoint file.
Actor was trained by supervised distillation only (300 updates, zero PPO updates). The actor-only critic is uncalibrated and no critic prediction error is reported.
No frozen zero-update checkpoint was included in this bounded smoke; the harness supports that control for a subsequent strength study.
note: Paired frozen-checkpoint comparison. Baselines and learned models are distinct policies. No automatic promotion.

limitations: RMST is expected min(lifetime, piece cap), not uncapped mean lifetime.
Action repeats are averaged within game seed; transitions are not independent samples.
Incomplete or duplicate repeat groups are excluded from paired inference.
Intervals condition on frozen checkpoints; they do not estimate training-seed variability.
Percentile bootstrap intervals from few game seeds are weak evidence; no automatic promotion.
